40007149.author: पदार्थः
40007149.content: ततः then, शूर्पणख्या by Surpanakha, एवम् in that way, रक्षसाम् of demons, मध्ये in the midst, आधर्षितः put to shame, शूरः hero, खरः Khara, खरतरम् harsher, वचः words, उवाच spoke.

40007149.author: Translation
40007149.content: Ashamed and accused thus in the presence of the demons, the valiant Khara spoke to Surpanakha in harsh words:

40007150.author: पदार्थः
40007150.content: तव your, अवमानप्रभवः arising out of insult, मम mine, अतुलः incomparable, अयं क्रोधः this anger, उल्बणम् excessive, लवणाम्भः salt water, इव like, धारयितुम् to bear, न शक्यते is not possible for me.

40007150.author: Translation
40007150.content: Like the overslowing salt sea water, I am unable to contain this my excessive anger arising out of your insult.

40007151.author: पदार्थः
40007151.content: मानुषम् human being, क्षीणजीवितम् shortlived, रामम् Rama, वीर्यात् due to valour, न गणये I do not count, यः he who has, आत्मदुश्चरितैः by his own bad conduct, हतः be killed, अद्य now, प्राणान् life, विमोक्ष्यते will leave.

40007151.author: Translation
40007151.content: Rama is a shortlived human. I do not care for his valour. His life span will be shortened (he will be killed) now for his own misdeeds.

40007152.author: पदार्थः
40007152.content: एषः this, बाष्पः tears, संह्रियाताम् may be controlled, सम्भ्रमश्च anxiety also, विमुच्यताम् give up, अहम् I, रामम् Rama, भ्रात्रा सह along with his brother, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, नयामि l will send.

40007152.author: Translation
40007152.content: Restrain your tears and your anxieties I will send Rama along with his brother to the abode of Yama.

40007153.author: पदार्थः
40007153.content: राक्षसि O demoness, अद्य now, संयुगे in the fight, परश्वथहतस्य of one killed by an axe, मन्दप्राणस्य whose life has gone slow, रामस्य Rama's, रक्तम् red, उष्णम् hot, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यसि you can drink.

40007153.author: Translation
40007153.content: With his life ebbing out, killed by my axe in the fight, you will drink today, O demoness, Rama's red, hot blood.

40007154.author: पदार्थः
40007154.content: सा she, खरस्य Khara's, वदनात् from the mouth, च्युतम् that came out, वचः the words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रहृष्टा she was pleased, मौर्ख्यात् due to stupidity, भ्रातरम् to the brother, रक्षसाम् among demons, वरम् great, पुनः again, प्रशशंस she praised.

40007154.author: Translation
40007154.content: On hearing the words that came out of Khara's mouth, she was pleased. And in stupidity began praising her brother once again as the best of demons.

40007155.author: पदार्थः
40007155.content: तया by her, पूर्वम् earlier, परुषितः been acused, पुनरेव again, प्रशंसितः was praised, खरः Khara, तदा then, दूषणं नाम Dooshana by name, सेनापतिम् army chief, अब्रवीत् said.

40007155.author: Translation
40007155.content: Khara, accused by her earlier and admired again, said to Dusana, chief of army:

40007156.author: पदार्थः
40007156.content: मम my, चित्तानुवर्तिनाम् acting according to will, भीमवेगानाम् of terrific speed, समरेषु in war, अनिवर्तिनाम् never turn back, रक्षसाम् of demons, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousand.

40007156.author: Translation
40007156.content: There are fourteen thousand demons at my command ready to act according to my will. They are warriors of terrific speed and will not retreat from the fight.

40007157.author: पदार्थः
40007157.content: नीलजीमूतवर्णानाम् of the colour of the dark blue cloud, घोराणां of dreadful, कृ़रकर्मणाम् those who commit cruel acts लोकहिंसाविहाराणां those who roam about torturing people, बलिनाम् of the strong, उग्रतेजसाम् very powerful people.

40007157.author: Translation
40007157.content: They are of the colour of the dark blue cloud, dreadful and merciless, strong and powerful fighters who roam about forturing people.

40007158.author: पदार्थः
40007158.content: सौम्यः handsome, शार्दूलदर्पाणां powerful like tigers, महास्यानां having large countenances, महौजसाम् mighty, उदीर्णानाम् of the arrogant, तेषां of all such, रक्षसां demons, सर्वोद्योगं कारय get ready.

40007158.author: Translation
40007158.content: O handsome one, get them all, powerful like tigers, demons with large countenances, mighty and arragant, ready (for the fight).

40007159.author: पदार्थः
40007159.content: सौम्य O good natured one, मे my, रथम् chariot, धनूंषि च bows too, शरान् arrows, चित्रान् wonderful, खङ्गांश्च swords, विविधाः of different kinds, शिताः sharp, शक्तीश्च missiles, क्षिप्रम् quickly, उपस्थापय get them ready.

40007159.author: Translation
40007159.content: O goodnatured one, get my chariot, bows and arrows, wonderful swords of different kinds and sharp missiles ready quickly.

40007160.author: पदार्थः
40007160.content: रणकोविदः expert in warfare, दुर्विनीतस्य of the immodest, रामस्य Rama's, वधार्थम् to kill, महात्मनाम् great self, पौलस्त्यानाम् those of Paulasthya family, अग्रे in front, निर्यातुम् to go, इच्छामि I desire.

40007160.author: Translation
40007160.content: O expert in warfare, I wish to lead those great warriors of Paulasthya family, to kill that immodest Rama.

40007161.author: पदार्थः
40007161.content: तस्य his (Khara's), इति this, ब्रुवाणस्य while (Khara was) telling, अथ at that time, दूषणः Dusana, सूर्यवर्णम् colour of the Sun, महारथम् huge chariot, शबलैः variegated colours, सदश्वैः good horses, युक्तम् fit, आचचक्षे indicated.

40007161.author: Translation
40007161.content: While Khara was speaking thus, Dusana reported that a huge chariot of the colour of the Sun yoked with good horses of variegated hues stood ready.

40007162.author: पदार्थः
40007162.content: सः खरः that Khara, मेरुशिखराकारम् looking like the peak of the mount Meru, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् decorated with best of gold, हेमचक्रम् having golden wheels, असम्बाधम् wellbuilt, वैदूर्यमयकूबरम् carriage pole studded with vaiduryas, काञ्चनैः gold, मत्स्यैः with fishes, पुष्पैः with flowers, द्रुमैः trees, शैलैः mountains, सूर्यैश्च Sun, मङ्गलैः with auspicious ones, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च flocks of birds, ताराभिः with stars, अभिसंवृतम् all surrounded by, ध्वजनिस्त्रिंशसम्पन्नम् equipped with flags and swords, किङ्किणीकविराजितम् with small bells, सदश्वयुक्तम् yoked to fine horses, रथम् chariot, अमर्षात् with impatience, अरुरोह  mounted.

40007162.author: Translation
40007162.content: Then the impatient Khara mounted the chariot that looked like the peak of mount Meru. It was decorated with pure gold, had golden wheels, poles studded with vaidurya. The carriage of the chariot was engraved with golden figures of fishes, flowers, trees, the Sun, stars, flocks of auspicious birds, flags and swords. Shining with small bells, it was yoked to fine horses.

40007163.author: पदार्थः
40007163.content: सः खरः that Khara, मेरुशिखराकारम् looking like the peak of the mount Meru, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् decorated with best of gold, हेमचक्रम् having golden wheels, असम्बाधम् wellbuilt, वैदूर्यमयकूबरम् carriage pole studded with vaiduryas, काञ्चनैः gold, मत्स्यैः with fishes, पुष्पैः with flowers, द्रुमैः trees, शैलैः mountains, सूर्यैश्च Sun, मङ्गलैः with auspicious ones, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च flocks of birds, ताराभिः with stars, अभिसंवृतम् all surrounded by, ध्वजनिस्त्रिंशसम्पन्नम् equipped with flags and swords, किङ्किणीकविराजितम् with small bells, सदश्वयुक्तम् yoked to fine horses, रथम् chariot, अमर्षात् with impatience, अरुरोह  mounted.

40007163.author: Translation
40007163.content: Then the impatient Khara mounted the chariot that looked like the peak of mount Meru. It was decorated with pure gold, had golden wheels, poles studded with vaidurya. The carriage of the chariot was engraved with golden figures of fishes, flowers, trees, the Sun, stars, flocks of auspicious birds, flags and swords. Shining with small bells, it was yoked to fine horses.

40007164.author: पदार्थः
40007164.content: सः खरः that Khara, मेरुशिखराकारम् looking like the peak of the mount Meru, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् decorated with best of gold, हेमचक्रम् having golden wheels, असम्बाधम् wellbuilt, वैदूर्यमयकूबरम् carriage pole studded with vaiduryas, काञ्चनैः gold, मत्स्यैः with fishes, पुष्पैः with flowers, द्रुमैः trees, शैलैः mountains, सूर्यैश्च Sun, मङ्गलैः with auspicious ones, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च flocks of birds, ताराभिः with stars, अभिसंवृतम् all surrounded by, ध्वजनिस्त्रिंशसम्पन्नम् equipped with flags and swords, किङ्किणीकविराजितम् with small bells, सदश्वयुक्तम् yoked to fine horses, रथम् chariot, अमर्षात् with impatience, अरुरोह  mounted.

40007164.author: Translation
40007164.content: Then the impatient Khara mounted the chariot that looked like the peak of mount Meru. It was decorated with pure gold, had golden wheels, poles studded with vaidurya. The carriage of the chariot was engraved with golden figures of fishes, flowers, trees, the Sun, stars, flocks of auspicious birds, flags and swords. Shining with small bells, it was yoked to fine horses.

40007165.author: पदार्थः
40007165.content: भीमविक्रमाः warriors of terrific prowess, राक्षसाः demons, रथस्थम् seated on the chariot, तम् him, निशाम्य seeing, एनम् him, महाबलम् very strong one, दूषणं च Dusana too, सम्परिवार्य after surrounding, तस्थुः stood by.

40007165.author: Translation
40007165.content: The demons of terrific prowess surounded Khara and Dusana and stood by, when they saw both of them mounting the chariot.

40007166.author: पदार्थः
40007166.content: रथस्थः from the chariot, खरस्तु Khara on his part, महेष्वासान् those holding great weapons, घोरवर्मायुधध्वजान् those wearing dreadful shields, bearing weapons and holding flags, तान् सर्वराक्षसान् all the demons, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, निर्यात march on, इति thus, अब्रवीत् ordered.

40007166.author: Translation
40007166.content: Khara mounted the chariot, saw the demons holding great weapons, wearing dreadful shields and holding flags, and ordered them to march.

40007167.author: पदार्थः
40007167.content: ततः then, घोरवर्मायुधध्वजम् wearing dreadful shields, holding weapons and banners, तत् that, राक्षसं सैन्यम् army of demons, महानादम् a loud noise, महाजवम् in great speed, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, निर्जगाम started.

40007167.author: Translation
40007167.content: Then the army of the demons wearing dreadful shields, holding weapons and flags, and making a loud noise started in great speed from Janasthanam.

40007168.author: पदार्थः
40007168.content: गृहीतैः took, हस्तस्थैः by those held in the hand, मुद्गरैः maces, पट्टिसैः piercing  weapons, शूलैः spears, सुतीक्ष्णैः sharp, परश्वधैः axes used in battle, खङ्गै swords, चक्रैश्च wheels, भ्राजमानैः shining splinters, तोमरैः iron clubs, शक्तिभिः powerful missiles, घोरैः dreadful, परिघैः iron bars, अतिमात्रैः of giant size, कार्मुकैः bows made of bamboo, गदासिमुसलैः pounding pestles, भीमदर्शनैः frightening to look at, वज्रैः weapons like thunderbolt, खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम् of those acting according to the wishes of Khara, सुघोराणाम् very fierce, राक्षसानाम् of demons, चतुर्दय सहस्राणि fourteen thousand, जनन्थानात् from Janasthana, निर्यातानि departed.

40007168.author: Translation
40007168.content: The fourteen thousand demons loyal to the wishes of Khara, took in their hands, maces, piercing weapons, spears, sharp axes used in battle, swords, wheels, splinters, iron clubs, powerful missiles, dreadful iron bars of giant size, bows made of bamboo, clubs and frightening weapons like thunderbolt (of Indra) and  departed from Janasthana.

40007169.author: पदार्थः
40007169.content: गृहीतैः took, हस्तस्थैः by those held in the hand, मुद्गरैः maces, पट्टिसैः piercing  weapons, शूलैः spears, सुतीक्ष्णैः sharp, परश्वधैः axes used in battle, खङ्गै swords, चक्रैश्च wheels, भ्राजमानैः shining splinters, तोमरैः iron clubs, शक्तिभिः powerful missiles, घोरैः dreadful, परिघैः iron bars, अतिमात्रैः of giant size, कार्मुकैः bows made of bamboo, गदासिमुसलैः pounding pestles, भीमदर्शनैः frightening to look at, वज्रैः weapons like thunderbolt, खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम् of those acting according to the wishes of Khara, सुघोराणाम् very fierce, राक्षसानाम् of demons, चतुर्दय सहस्राणि fourteen thousand, जनन्थानात् from Janasthana, निर्यातानि departed.

40007169.author: Translation
40007169.content: The fourteen thousand demons loyal to the wishes of Khara, took in their hands, maces, piercing weapons, spears, sharp axes used in battle, swords, wheels, splinters, iron clubs, powerful missiles, dreadful iron bars of giant size, bows made of bamboo, clubs and frightening weapons like thunderbolt (of Indra) and  departed from Janasthana.

40007170.author: पदार्थः
40007170.content: गृहीतैः took, हस्तस्थैः by those held in the hand, मुद्गरैः maces, पट्टिसैः piercing  weapons, शूलैः spears, सुतीक्ष्णैः sharp, परश्वधैः axes used in battle, खङ्गै swords, चक्रैश्च wheels, भ्राजमानैः shining splinters, तोमरैः iron clubs, शक्तिभिः powerful missiles, घोरैः dreadful, परिघैः iron bars, अतिमात्रैः of giant size, कार्मुकैः bows made of bamboo, गदासिमुसलैः pounding pestles, भीमदर्शनैः frightening to look at, वज्रैः weapons like thunderbolt, खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम् of those acting according to the wishes of Khara, सुघोराणाम् very fierce, राक्षसानाम् of demons, चतुर्दय सहस्राणि fourteen thousand, जनन्थानात् from Janasthana, निर्यातानि departed.

40007170.author: Translation
40007170.content: The fourteen thousand demons loyal to the wishes of Khara, took in their hands, maces, piercing weapons, spears, sharp axes used in battle, swords, wheels, splinters, iron clubs, powerful missiles, dreadful iron bars of giant size, bows made of bamboo, clubs and frightening weapons like thunderbolt (of Indra) and  departed from Janasthana.

40007171.author: पदार्थः
40007171.content: अभिद्रवतः going speedily to attack, भीमविक्रमान् of frightening prowess, तान् राक्षसान् those demons, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, किञ्चित् a little, तदनन्तरम् behind, खरस्य Khara's, रथः chariot, अपि too, जगाम went.

40007171.author: Translation
40007171.content: Khara's chariot moved a bit behind the army of demons of frightening prowess who rushed forward to attack (Rama).

40007172.author: पदार्थः
40007172.content: ततः thereafter, सारथिः charioteer, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषितान् decorated with pure gold, शबलान्  colourful, तान् them, अश्वान् horses, खरस्य of Khara's, मतिम् mind, आज्ञाय knowing, समचोदयत् hastened.

40007172.author: Translation
40007172.content: Knowing the mind of Khara, the charioteer hastened the horses of the colourful  chariot decorated with pure gold.

40007173.author: पदार्थः
40007173.content: तदा then, रिपुघातिनः killers of enemy, खरस्य Khara's, शीघ्रम् speedily, चोदितः spurred, सः रथः that chariot, दिशश्च the four directions, प्रदिशश्च intermediate directions, शब्देन by the sound, आपूरयामास filled.

40007173.author: Translation
40007173.content: Spurred by the charioteer, the chariot of Khara, the slayer of enemies, produced a rattle that filled all four quarters and the intermediate directions.

40007174.author: पदार्थः
40007174.content: प्रवृद्धमन्युः whose anger increased, खरस्वनः with harsh tone, खरः Khara, रिपोः enemy's, वधार्थम् to kill, त्वरितः at quick pace, अन्तकः यथा like Yama, the god of death, अश्मवर्षवान् like hail stones, महाबलः powerful, मेघः इव like the cloud, घनम् heavy, उन्नदन् सारथिम् roaring charioteer, अचूचुदत् impelled him to drive.

40007174.author: Translation
40007174.content: Khara in extreme anger hastened, like Yama, to slay his enemy. He roared loudly like a cloud raining hail stones and impelled his charioteer to speed up. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वालल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysecond sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
